SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID AS employeeId, FIRST_NAME AS firstName, JOB_TITLE AS jobTitle, LAST_NAME AS lastName, FIRST_NAME || ' ' || LAST_NAME AS employeeName, PHONE AS phone, EMAIL AS email, TO_CHAR(HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hireDate, MANAGER_ID AS managerId, FN_MAN_NM(EMPLOYEE_ID) AS managerName FROM EMPLOYEES
AND ( UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(FIRST_NAME || LAST_NAME), ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(#{employeeName}), ' ', '')) || '%' )
AND HIRE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{hireDateFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND HIRE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{hireDateTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND MANAGER_ID = #{managerId}
ORDER BY EMPLOYEE_ID

WITH MANAGER_COND AS (
SELECT TRIM(REGEXP_SUBSTR(#{managerId}, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL)) AS managerName FROM DUAL CONNECT BY REGEXP_SUBSTR(#{managerId}, '[^,]+', 1, LEVEL) IS NOT NULL ) SELECT E.EMPLOYEE_ID AS employeeId, E.FIRST_NAME AS firstName, E.JOB_TITLE AS jobTitle, E.LAST_NAME AS lastName, E.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || E.LAST_NAME AS employeeName, E.PHONE AS phone, E.EMAIL AS email, TO_CHAR(E.HIRE_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS hireDate, E.MANAGER_ID AS managerId, FN_MAN_NM(E.EMPLOYEE_ID) AS managerName FROM EMPLOYEES E
AND ( UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(E.FIRST_NAME || E.LAST_NAME), ' ', '')) LIKE '%' || UPPER(REPLACE(TRIM(#{employeeName}), ' ', '')) || '%' )
AND E.HIRE_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{hireDateFrom}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND E.HIRE_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{hireDateTo}, 'YYYY-MM-DD')
AND FN_MAN_NM(E.EMPLOYEE_ID) IN ( SELECT managerName FROM MANAGER_COND )
ORDER BY E.EMPLOYEE_ID

SELECT EMPLOYEE_ID AS employeeId, FIRST_NAME AS firstName, LAST_NAME AS lastName, EMAIL AS email, CASE WHEN INSTR(EMAIL, '@') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(EMAIL, 1, INSTR(EMAIL, '@') - 1) ELSE EMAIL END AS emailId, CASE WHEN INSTR(EMAIL, '@') > 0 THEN SUBSTR(EMAIL, INSTR(EMAIL, '@') + 1) ELSE '' END AS emailDomain, PHONE AS phone, TO_CHAR(HIRE_DATE, 'YYYYMMDD') AS hireDate, JOB_TITLE AS jobTitle, MANAGER_ID AS managerId, FN_MAN_NM(EMPLOYEE_ID) AS managerName FROM EMPLOYEES WHERE EMPLOYEE_ID = #{employeeId}
SELECT DISTINCT M.EMPLOYEE_ID AS managerId, M.FIRST_NAME || ' ' || M.LAST_NAME AS managerName FROM EMPLOYEES E, EMPLOYEES M WHERE E.MANAGER_ID = M.EMPLOYEE_ID ORDER BY managerName
SELECT DISTINCT E.JOB_TITLE AS code, E.JOB_TITLE AS name FROM EMPLOYEES E WHERE E.JOB_TITLE IS NOT NULL ORDER BY E.JOB_TITLE
